no_results.title: No assessments yet

severity_desc.normal: You're in a healthy mental state. Keep maintaining your well-being and self-care routines.
severity_desc.mild: You're feeling emotionally drained. Make sure to get plenty of rest. This is a safe space for you to take a short break.
severity_desc.moderate: You're experiencing moderate emotional distress. Consider reaching out to someone you trust.
severity_desc.severe: You're going through significant emotional challenges. We strongly recommend consulting a professional.
severity_desc.extremely_severe: You're experiencing very high levels of distress. Please seek professional help immediately.

mindCheckFlow.description: You will answer 21 short questions to measure your current mental health level. Answer honestly based on your experience over the past 1 week.
mindCheckFlow.disclaimer: These results are informational and not a medical diagnosis. If your symptoms persist, please consult a mental health professional.

never.label: Never
never.desc: Did not apply to me at all

sometimes.label: Sometimes
sometimes.desc: Applied to me to some degree, or some of the time

often.label: Often
often.desc: Applied to me to a considerable degree or a good part of time

almostAlways.label: Almost Always
almostAlways.desc: Applied to me very much or most of the time

questions.q1: I found it hard to wind down.
questions.q2: I was aware of dryness of my mouth.
questions.q3: I couldn't seem to experience any positive feeling at all.
questions.q4: I experienced breathing difficulty (e.g. excessively rapid breathing, breathlessness in the absence of physical exertion).
questions.q5: I found it difficult to work up the initiative to do things.
questions.q6: I tended to over-react to situations.
questions.q7: I experienced trembling (e.g. in the hands).
questions.q8: I felt that I was using a lot of nervous energy.
questions.q9: I was worried about situations in which I might panic and make a fool of myself.
questions.q10: I felt that I had nothing to look forward to.
questions.q12: I found it difficult to relax.
questions.q14: I was intolerant of anything that kept me from getting on with what I was doing.
questions.q15: I felt I was close to panic.
questions.q16: I was unable to become enthusiastic about anything.
questions.q17: I felt I wasn't worth much as a person.
questions.q18: I felt that I was rather touchy.
questions.q19: I was aware of the action of my heart in the absence of physical exertion.
questions.q20: I felt scared without any good reason.
questions.q21: I felt that life was meaningless.
